lines.text: Where the bank is, not where is!
Many learners say: Can you tell me where is the bank?
Better: Can you tell me where the bank is?
The second! Where the bank is.

data.wrong: Can you tell me where is the bank?
data.right: Can you tell me where the bank is?
data.memory: Can you tell me where the bank is?

native.tip: Tek başına soruda “Where is the bank?” deriz; ama “Can you tell me” sonrası düz sıra gelir: “Can you tell me where the bank is?”
native.caption: “Can you tell me where is the bank?” mi diyorsun? 😅 “Can you tell me” sonrasında düz cümle sırası gelir: önce “the bank”, sonra “is”. Doğrusu “Can you tell me where the bank is?” Ama’yı dinle ve tekrar et! Lexkite uygulamasını aç, daha çok pratik yap.
native.comment: Cevap: “the bank is”. Sıra düz cümle gibi olur. Şimdi kendi cümleni yaz ve sesli söyle: {link}

en.tip: After “Can you tell me,” use a plain sentence order: “Can you tell me where the bank is?”
en.caption: Do you say “Can you tell me where is the bank?” 😅 After “Can you tell me” the order is like a plain sentence: first “the bank” and then “is” at the end. The right sentence is “Can you tell me where the bank is?” Listen to Ama and repeat! Open the Lexkite app and practice more.
